Name: Text Typer
Author: TylerDurden67
Description: Type text with a configurable per-character delay, an optional key press before typing (e.g. to open a game's chat), and an optional Enter at the end - all in a single reliable action.

Actions.Name: Type Text
Actions.Tooltip: Type a text (with per-character delay), optionally press a key first, optionally press Enter at the end.
